title: Career Ops disrupts AI job search #careerops #airesume #jobsearchai
description:
Career Ops turned one job seeker’s failed application grind into a highly targeted AI-assisted search that checked 740 roles and surfaced only the ones worth pursuing. The tool gained attention on Twitter after helping him go from being fired with no job to landing a top AI role.

The system reads a job posting, compares it against a resume, scores whether the role is worth applying to, and then automates the next steps for strong matches. If a job scores above 4 out of 5, it tailors the resume, estimates salary positioning, and prepares interview answers.

The broader appeal is efficiency: instead of sending dozens of generic LinkedIn applications and hearing nothing back, users can focus time on higher-probability opportunities. With more than 8,200 people already using it for free and a non-technical setup path, Career Ops reflects a growing shift toward AI tools that optimize job search strategy rather than just application volume.
